systems.system: Guichet Unique de Création d'Entreprise (GUCE) mobile caravans
systems.owner: GUCE, with the World Bank's USD 300 million TRANSFORME project
systems.tiers: temporary deployment of Kinshasa-based staff to Mbuji-Mayi and Kananga (April and July 2025) and Bunia (November 2025), registering 4,613 businesses; permanent offices in a handful of locations; online registration is being worked on

note: Business registration only, which the typology puts out of scope with land and electoral registers; nothing on civil registration.
